svg.title: Sketch sums equal head sums. Path bounds make live, masked plain, proxy, fade and summit sums absolute; the identity also proves loan summability. Finite seat averaging preserves this, justifying all cancellations. The reset additive sum is untagged plus F∆+ Hα,∆; its attached log sum is dust plus Lα,∆. Substitution into τ ′|Site|−inChannels(β′)−additive, using channel decomposition, yields Ereset(U) + X i logi(U) = Efrozen(U) −αR(U).
